description: This file defines a React functional component 'GuardrailTestPlayground' that provides a user interface for selecting guardrails, searching, and testing them by applying network calls. It manages local state for selected guardrails, search query, test results, and test errors. It interacts with external modules like 'applyGuardrail' for testing guardrails and 'NotificationsManager' for user notifications.

methods.name: GuardrailTestPlayground
methods.description: Main React functional component managing guardrail testing interface, including state and event handlers.

methods.name: handleTestGuardrails
methods.description: Asynchronous function to test selected guardrails by invoking 'applyGuardrail' for each, handling success and errors, updating state, and triggering notifications.

methods.name: toggleGuardrailSelection
methods.description: Function to add or remove guardrails from the selected set when user toggles selection.
